title: Weekly Review

week.convention: Weeks run Sunday → Saturday by analytical trade date.

outcome.hint: Results only. A profitable week is not evidence of good process, and a losing week is not evidence of bad process.
outcome.profitFactorUndefined: Undefined: no losing Trades this week

process.hint: Measured from your Rule evaluations only. P&L is never an input.
process.formula: Compliance = {{pass}} / ({{pass}} + {{fail}}). {{na}} and {{unreviewed}} are excluded; review completeness is shown separately.
process.emptyNoStrategy: None of this week's Trades is associated with a Strategy, so nothing has been evaluated. Process metrics appear once Trades are assigned to a Strategy Version.
process.emptyUnreviewed: Rules have not been judged yet for this week's Trades. Compliance stays undefined until at least one rule is marked {{pass}} or {{fail}}.
process.excludedNoStrategy_one: {{count}} Trade without a Strategy is not part of the process metrics.
process.excludedNoStrategy_other: {{count}} Trades without a Strategy are not part of the process metrics.

progress.hint: How much of the week has been judged and documented. Process only — P&L is never an input.
progress.reviewFormula: Trades with every rule judged, out of all Trades of the week. A Trade without a Strategy cannot be reviewed.

achievements.hint: Recognition for process and review habits — never for P&L.

reviewComplete.label: Review complete
reviewComplete.criteria: All scorecard dimensions rated, and What went well, What needs improvement and Next week focus written.

tradesReviewed.label: All Trades reviewed
tradesReviewed.criteria: Every Trade this week has all of its rules judged.

noRuleFails.label: No {{fail}} recorded
noRuleFails.criteria: Rules were judged this week and none was recorded as {{fail}}.

cleanProcess.label: Clean process week
cleanProcess.criteria: Every Trade has a Strategy and a complete review, with no {{fail}} and at least one {{pass}}.

forecastCompleted.label: Forecast completed
forecastCompleted.criteria: Both Forecast / Intention and Actual are written.

consistentReviewer.label: Consistent reviewer
consistentReviewer.criteria: A review written for {{count}} consecutive weeks, including this one.

forecast.forecastHint: What you expected or intended before the week. Written by you — Solid Skill never generates forecasts.
forecast.forecastPlaceholder: Conditions you expect, what you intend to focus on, what you will avoid…
forecast.actualHint: What actually happened, in your words.
forecast.actualPlaceholder: How the week actually unfolded compared with the forecast…
forecast.editedDuringWeek: edited on or after the week started

rules.hint: Factual counts from your evaluations, each read against the exact Strategy Version the Trade was evaluated with.
rules.disclaimer: Outcomes of the Trades where a rule was failed are shown for context only. They do not show that the rule caused the result.
rules.noViolations: No rule was recorded as {{fail}} this week.
rules.noEvaluations: No Rule evaluations for this week.

trades.hint: Click a row to inspect. Double-click or Enter opens the full Trade Review.
trades.empty: No Trades recorded for this account this week.

charts.hint: Day charts and each Trade's featured chart. Shown from the existing files — nothing is copied.
charts.empty: No Chart Evidence attached to this week's days or Trades.

reflection.wentWellPlaceholder: Process you executed well, regardless of outcome…
reflection.nextWeekFocusPlaceholder: One or two concrete process goals…

scorecard.hint: Your own assessment of how you conducted yourself this week, from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent). Independent of P&L.
scorecard.clearHint: Select the current score again to clear it.

discipline.label: Discipline
discipline.hint: Followed your plan and your own rules.

patience.label: Patience
patience.hint: Waited for your conditions instead of forcing Trades.

risk_management.label: Risk management
risk_management.hint: Sized and protected positions as planned.

execution_quality.label: Execution quality
execution_quality.hint: Entries, management and exits carried out as intended.

focus.label: Focus
focus.hint: Attention stayed on the session and the plan.

review_quality.label: Review quality
review_quality.hint: Trades, days and the week documented honestly.

save.error: Couldn't save — your text is kept here.

dayNote.placeholder:
Plan / expectation
What happened
What went well
What could improve
dayNote.hint: Your daily reflection for this account and date.

noAccount: Select an account to review a week.
